definitions.gap: At periodic crossing vertices (0,0.5),(0.5,0): replace centered square of side w by CPC phase0. N200 resolves every selected width exactly. Fixed raster outside patches.
definitions.rounding: Periodic disk morphological opening of each conductive phase1,2; removed convex corners filled by phase0; stated radius measured in unit-cell units.
definitions.ensemble: Each phase periodic signed distance perturbed by smooth zero-mean Gaussian field, max amplitude0.02 cell, correlation length0.08 cell; argmax determines labels. p4 cases rotate-average each field; random seed20261024. Does not guarantee topology preservation.
definitions.certificate: Conforming sector primal and dual variational enclosures for the stated fixed pixel geometry; quadrature and floating-point rounding not interval certified.

refinement_limit: N200 m2 nr2 factorization exceeded available memory; reported N200 m1 nr1 enclosures already establish Sa>40 for each tested gap. No extrapolated interval is used.
